title: Save $50 on the Best Nintendo Switch 2 Bundle
gist: Wired deals roundup: Nintendo, which rarely discounts first-party titles, is running Black Friday 2026 discounts on Switch 2 bundles ($50 off the Mario Kart World bundle at $500; $28 off the Sports Resort bundle at $530) and $20 off several first-party Switch 2 games, via the Nintendo Store and major retailers.

insights.claim: Nintendo rarely discounts its first-party game titles, unlike the broader video game market where prices generally drop quickly, making its Black Friday 2026 discounts on Switch 2 bundles and games unusual.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Nintendo discounting even modestly signals a shift in its historically rigid pricing discipline; watch for whether it extends beyond holiday promos.
insights.quote: Nintendo is a bit of an exception to the rule—it rarely discounts its first-party titles
insights.locator: While video games generally drop in price quickly

insights.claim: The Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle (console, full game download and a 3-month Nintendo Switch Online membership) is discounted from $550 to $500 (9% off) at the Nintendo Store, Walmart and Best Buy for Black Friday 2026.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: A ~9% hardware-bundle discount gives a read on Switch 2 holiday price elasticity and Nintendo's willingness to trade margin for unit volume.

insights.claim: The Nintendo Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle is discounted by about $28 to $530 for Black Friday 2026.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Second discounted SKU suggests Nintendo is pushing multiple bundles rather than a single loss-leader.
insights.locator: Nintendo Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Bundle

insights.claim: Several first-party Nintendo Switch 2 games, including Metroid Prime 4: Beyond, Donkey Kong Bananza, Kirby Air Riders and Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2, are $20 off for Black Friday 2026, with the same discounts expected on physical copies at major retailers.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Software discounting of first-party titles is a margin lever for Nintendo; useful datapoint for holiday software attach-rate expectations.
insights.locator: Best Black Friday Nintendo Switch Game Deals
